title: Ambient ringed square is exact localization of its ordinary square
statement: For a chosen cartesian scheme square with coherent ring sheaves r [def-weil-pbc-strict-tower-operations], its canonical ambient derived inverse-image comparison equals Functor.mapDerivedCategorySquareIso of r.exchangeModuleSquare. Thus the normalized geometric square and exact localization use precisely the same compositor and equality transport.

proof.text: Use canonical derived pullback normalization on each composable pair. The conjugateEquiv characterization identifies its ordinary left comparison with exchangeModuleComposition.
Exact localization preserves the inverse, composite, and equality transport. Substitute the preceding identities in the two definitions of the square.

lean.statement:
theorem StrictTowerRingedSquare.ambientSquare_localization
    {X' X Y' Y : Scheme.{t}} {g' : X' ⟶ X} {f' : X' ⟶ Y'}
    {f : X ⟶ Y} {g : Y' ⟶ Y} {sq : ChosenCartesianSquare g' f' f g}
    (r : StrictTowerRingedSquare sq) :
    proEtaleAmbientRingedPullbackComparison sq r.RX r.RY r.RX' r.RY'
        r.cf r.cg r.cg' r.cf' r.coherent =
      Functor.mapDerivedCategorySquareIso r.exchangeModuleSquare
